mutants.id: M1 revert SCC-303: drop the untracked sweep entirely
mutants.original:
untracked = [u for u in others
                     if str(Path(u).parent) in dirs
                     or any(str(Path(u)).startswith(d + "/") for d in dirs if d != ".")]
        files += [u for u in untracked if u not in files]
mutants.case: I1 an untracked .md with a dead path in a diffed dir must NOT produce a clean exit 0
mutants.block: I · SCC-303 · --base must not narrow its own scope silently

mutants.id: M2 sweep EVERY untracked .md, ignoring the diff's directories
mutants.original:
untracked = [u for u in others
                     if str(Path(u).parent) in dirs
                     or any(str(Path(u)).startswith(d + "/") for d in dirs if d != ".")]
mutants.case: I4 CONTROL: an untracked .md OUTSIDE the diff's directories stays out of scope

mutants.id: M3 stop printing the scanned names

mutants.original: print(f"  [scanned] {f}" + ("  (untracked - swept in)" if f in swept else ""))
